gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.machine_fra: Every machine starts with parts: Machine Frames, Circuit Boards and Nero Coils. Craft your first component and the workshop is open.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.nero_genera: The Nero Generator burns coal and fuel into NE — your first power source. It runs hot and it smokes: every burn adds to the region's pollution. Remember that.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.solar_array: The Solar Array trickles clean power while the sun is up — weaker than combustion, but it adds nothing to the smog and never asks for fuel.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.clear_skies: A bank of four Solar Arrays can carry a small base through the day. Clean capacity now means less scrubbing later.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.ore_process: The Ore Processor grinds raw ore into double dust. Feed it power, keep it cool, and your mining trips pay out twice.
The Fabricator presses refined materials into Machine Frames, Circuit Boards and Nero Coils — the component line every later machine is built on.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.advanced_or: The Advanced Ore Processor's plasma arc handles Starsteel and planet ores with bonus yield. It needs the orbital metals Nerospace brings home.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.advanced_fa: The Advanced Fabricator assembles space-tier components — including the Fusion Cells the reactor burns. The top of the processing chain.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.heat_manage: Working machines build heat; an overheated machine throttles. Machines shed heat faster beside water, ice and snow — stock coolant before the red gauge does it for you.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.dirty_filte: Pollution is regional and it lingers. A fouled filter, black with everything your machines put into the air, is the receipt. Reprocess it in the Ore Processor for a partial iron refund.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.scrubber.te: The Scrubber eats pollution out of its region while it has power and a Filter Cartridge. Park one beside your generators and change the filter when it fouls.
The Remediator goes further than the Scrubber: it restores ground scarred by heavy pollution, sweeping its booms over the land until the region reads clean.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.auto_crafte: Lock a recipe into the Auto Crafter's grid and it stamps out the product for as long as it has power and ingredients. Retire the crafting bench.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.item_sorter: The Item Sorter routes streams by filter, side by side. Give each face a filter and the factory sorts itself.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.configurato: The Configurator sets each machine face to in / out / off, and copies one machine's side config onto the next. The last piece of a hands-free line.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.analytics_t: The Analytics Terminal watches every machine in range: status, efficiency, heat and the region's pollution on one dashboard. Every machine also carries its own analytics tab.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.fusion_cont: A fusion torus needs a formed hollow shell — Fusion Casing walls with a Containment Glass viewport, 3x3x3 up to 5x5x5. Bigger shells burn hotter fuels.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.fusion_reac: The Fusion Reactor controller validates the shell and lights the torus. Watch the heat: a starved or broken shell risks meltdown, and meltdowns are not gentle.
gui.nerotech.tech_guide.step.stellar_fue: Fuel tiers climb from Fusion Cells through Plasma Cells to Stellar Cells — each hotter, denser and pickier about its shell. A Stellar Cell in hand means the top of the tech tree.
command.nerotech.gallery.built: Built the NeroTech gallery: %s blocks on the display grid, 4 live processing lines (ore → dust, iron → frames, Void Crystal → Fusion Cells), a coal-burning Nero Generator charging a Battery with a Scrubber eating its emissions, a Solar Array, a Remediator, an Auto Crafter mid-craft, an Item Sorter routing its front stream, an Analytics Terminal watching the strip, a loaded Tech Guide pedestal at the centre, and formed 3×3×3 + 5×5×5 Fusion Reactor shells burning their tier fuels.
command.nerotech.gallery.cleared: Cleared the NeroTech gallery: %s blocks → air, %s entities removed.
